goal: Verify whether PayGrid webhook gateway retains Idempotency-Key headers in Redis for 72 hours to prevent duplicate transactions.
successCriteria: Check idempotency retention duration and deduplication behavior in PayGrid.

evidence.passage: PayGrid persists every Idempotency-Key header in distributed Redis cache with a strict TTL of 72 hours (259200 seconds), returning HTTP 200 with original body on duplicate submissions.

proposedAnswer: PayGrid webhook gateway retains Idempotency-Key headers in Redis for 72 hours to prevent duplicate transactions.
